messages:
maria: Heads-up — production traces show a spike of 503/handshake_failure for EU->US internal RPCs starting ~06:20 UTC. Not a full outage but elevated error rate. Anyone seen similar?

alex: saw the alert. quick grep of logs shows OpenSSL `dh key` alert on the client side. sample from proxy: `ssl: TLSv1.3 alert internal error: error:0A00018E:SSL routines:evp_pkey_decrypt:unsupported`

jamal: hm. that usually points to KMS unwrap failing for the server cert key. EU proxies use vault-to-kms keywrap; US side upgraded HSM-only key policy last week. Could be cross-region unwrap blocked.

maria: can we confirm KMS Decrypt errors in audit logs? we need to know if it's policy (403) or crypto mismatch. @infra-bot can you dump recent KMS/Decrypt audit events for key alias redwood/proxy-key in us-west-2 and eu-west-1?

infra-bot: (automated) pulled last 200 CloudAudit entries for KMS Decrypt on redwood/proxy-key: 1) us-west-2: 12 successes, 7 failures (KMS:AccessDenied) between 06:18-06:30; 2) eu-west-1: 0 failures. Full snippet attached in incident ticket #INC-3342.

oncall-dave: AccessDenied. sounds like a RBAC/policy regression. Did the key's keyPolicy change to require VPC endpoint or a specific principal? Jamal — can you check key policy diff?

jamal: grabbing diffs now. earlier change: `RequireExternalKeyManager: true` on the us-west-2 HSM key to enforce HSM origin; also tightened principal to `arn:aws:iam::account:role/proxy-crypto`. EU clusters still use `proxy-issuer` service account IAM role via workload identity. So per-region principal mismatch.

maria: that explains it. Two follow-ups: 1) immediate mitigation so traffic doesn't fail; 2) longer-term fix for cross-region key/issuer sync and audit.

alex: mitigation options: a) add the proxy-issuer role ARN to us-west-2 key policy (fast, but security trade-off), b) create a regional dedicated key for EU->US traffic (more secure), c) fallback to ephemeral certs signed by internal CA until policy is aligned. I'm leaning to (a) temporarily with strict audit and revert window.

oncall-dave: agreed to (a) with guardrails. I'll update key policy and add an automated alert for any KMS Decrypt operation from `proxy-issuer` outside a 1h window.

jamal: one caveat — our cert-manager setup on the kube side uses the KMS plugin with region-specific config in the Issuer CR. Example:```
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata:
  name: proxy-ca-eu
spec:
  acme: {}
  # plugin: awskms
  # region: eu-west-1
  # keyAlias: redwood/proxy-key
```
If we add an ARN to the key policy, both EU and US issuers will be able to unwrap; need to ensure we don't accidentally allow service accounts from other clusters. Add condition on `kms:EncryptionContext:source` or `aws:PrincipalTag` to tighten.

maria: good point. let's use request-context to limit by `cluster` tag, and require `kms:ViaService` condition for cross-account. Also add an RBAC ticket: `ENGSEC-847` to update role bindings so proxy-issuer's ServiceAccount annotation `iam.amazonaws.com/role` maps properly per region.

sec-scan-bot: (scan) vulnerability check on cert rotation flow: found 1 high risk — missing TLS min-version enforcement on the proxy listener for legacy clients. Current config allows TLS1.2 down-negotiation. Recommend `minVersion: TLS1.3` for internal plane and `TLS1.2` for public-facing only.

alex: noted. We'll push a proxy config change to enforce min TLS1.3 for internal mTLS channels. Quick config snippet:```
listeners:
  internal:
    tls_min_version: TLS1_3
    mTLS: REQUIRED
  public:
    tls_min_version: TLS1_2
```

oncall-dave: action items: 1) I'll patch us-west-2 key policy to include `arn:aws:iam::account:role/proxy-issuer` for 2h window and enable CloudAudit alerts (DONE) ; 2) Jamal to add principal tag condition and submit PR for key policy rollback + stronger condition (ETA 2h); 3) Alex to prepare proxy TLS min-version PR (ETA 4h); 4) Maria to update incident doc and coordinate postmortem (INC-3342). :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone. after rollback we should run full e2e: issue cert -> unwrap -> start session, and confirm metrics stable for 30m. I'll post follow-up in the thread when green. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: (automated) incident INC-3342 updated: mitigation applied, key policy patched, audit alerts configured.

maria: verified green at 07:05 UTC — error rate back to baseline. leaving this thread open until PRs merge and policy reverts with conditional tags.

alex: will add follow-up note to run regular policy drift job across regions to catch HSM-only toggles.

maria: filed ENGSEC-848 for the drift job. closing loop after postmortem.
